text: On holiday near the Spanish and Portuguese border, Virginia leaps from a train in a jealous rage and camps for the night in the ruined medieval town of Berzano. There, legend says, [the Knights Templar rise from their tombs|threat|the dead that rise], blind because birds [pecked out their eyes on the gallows|images|ropes, cages and executions]. Her friends Betty and Roger go looking for the truth, but the knights [track their victims by their heartbeats|rules|how it hunts], and a passing train offers the only escape.
